content: Season One of Ted: The Animated Series is streaming Dec 17 on Peacock: https://pck.tv/45hBP6q Synopsis: From Seth MacFarlane, comes TED: The Animated Series, a sequel to the beloved "Ted" and "Ted 2" films. This series reunites MacFarlane, who reprises his role as the voice of Ted, with his big screen castmates: Mark Wahlberg, as the voice of Ted's best friend, John; Amanda Seyfried, as the voice of John's wife, Sam; and Jessica Barth as Ted's wife, Tami-Lynn. Picking up twelve years after the conclusion of the last movie, John and his thunder-buddy Ted are neighbors, both with families of their own and dead-end jobs. Follow these two lovable stoners as they enable each other's bad ideas about marriage, parenting and the challenges of adult life. Peacock is a streaming service from NBCUniversal. With tons of hit movies and TV shows, Originals, current NBC & Bravo hits, and LIVE Sports including Sunday Night Football and Premier League, Peacock is here for whatever you’re in the mood for, from binge-watching to channel surfing. Currently available to stream within the United States. chineseContent: 《泰迪熊：动画系列》第一季将于 12 月 17 日在 Peacock 上播出：https://pck.tv/45hBP6q 剧情简介：塞斯·麦克法兰出品的《泰德：动画系列》是深受喜爱的《泰迪熊》和《泰迪熊 2》的续集。在这部剧中，麦克法兰再次为泰德配音，他和他的大银幕搭档再次聚首：马克·沃尔伯格，为泰德最好的朋友约翰配音；马克·沃尔伯格，为泰德最好的朋友约翰配音；阿曼达·塞弗里德 (Amanda Seyfried) 为约翰的妻子山姆 (Sam) 配音；杰西卡·巴斯饰演泰德的妻子塔米-林恩。上一部电影结束十二年后，约翰和他的雷霆好友泰德是邻居，两人都有自己的家庭和没有出路的工作。跟随这两个可爱的瘾君子，了解他们对婚姻、养育子女和成人生活挑战的坏想法。 Peacock 是 NBCUniversal 的流媒体服务。 Peacock 提供海量热门电影和电视节目、原创节目、NBC 和 Bravo 热门节目以及体育直播（包括周日橄榄球之夜和英超联赛），无论您想看什么，从狂看到频道冲浪，Peacock 都能满足您的所有需求。目前可在美国境内播放。获取更多 Peacock： ► 在 TikTok 上关注 Peacock：https://www.tiktok.com/@peacock ► 在 Instagram 上关注 Peacock：https://www.instagram.com/peacock ► 在 Facebook 上为 Peacock 点赞：https://www.facebook.com/PeacockTV ► 在 X 上关注 Peacock：https://twitter.com/peacock
